title: Tacx rider profile
description: A rider for tacx_neo.py. See workout_format.md. Workouts take FTP and weight from here.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor IntelliSense. Ignored by the program.

nickname.description: Short name shown on the dashboard. Defaults to name.

dob.description: Date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Used to estimate max HR when max_hr isn't given.

sex.description: Reserved for future calorie and zone estimates.

weight_kg.description: Rider weight in kg. Sent to the trainer for slope-mode physics, and used for W/kg.

ftp.description: Functional threshold power in watts. Every ftp_pct workout target is a percentage of this.

ftp_tested.description: When the FTP was last tested, YYYY-MM-DD.

bike_weight_kg.description: Bike weight in kg, sent to the trainer. Default 8.
